items.title: The category of locally quasi-compact Hausdorff spaces has fibre products, a final object and quasi-compact fibre products of quasi-compact objects

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma verifies the categorical and quasi-compactness properties of the category LC of locally quasi-compact Hausdorff spaces (statement lines 7473-7479). The proof (proof lines 7481-7503) uses that the fibre product is a subspace of the product for Hausdorffness, Tychonoff together with closedness for quasi-compactness, and a two-neighbourhood argument for the general case. H2: three short topological steps, written out.
